decision_reason: The missing pre-V46 restore point is a genuine process deviation, but it cannot be recreated after the successful append-only migration. Product and data checks show no loss, and a verified post-V46 recovery point contains the accepted new schema and test records.

causal_assessment.hypothesis: The first backup command selected the container default database instead of the active DB_URL database.
supporting_evidence: The first backup target did not match ccb_platform_req034_runtime2_20260818.
The mismatch was discovered only after Flyway V46 had completed.
causal_assessment.falsifier: A pre-V46 dump header or restore log naming ccb_platform_req034_runtime2_20260818 would disprove the mismatch, but none exists.

invariants: Do not roll back or rewrite the successfully executed V46 migration
Do not delete the real-flow test records
Do not modify unrelated repository files
control_action.impact_limit: Evidence and future migration procedure only; no product, schema or business-data write
control_action.rollback: Not applicable to the historical backup miss; retain the verified post-V46 backup unchanged
correction_check: Post-V46 backup restores 100 tables with matching release row counts
Flyway schema history reports V46 success
Full backend tests, real API flow and browser flow pass
For future migrations, compare backup database name to DB_URL and restore-verify before Flyway startup

residual_risk: Recovery cannot return the actual runtime database to its exact pre-V46 state; the verified post-V46 backup is the earliest valid recovery point
